sections.heading: Explore *digital twin simulation* for operations
sections.body:
A digital twin connects a model of an asset or process with operational data, helping teams understand current conditions and explore possible changes. The Digital Twin Suite brings reusable model starting points; the asset boundary, fidelity, calibration and integrations must reflect your environment.

[Assess a twin use case](#get-in-touch). Describe the asset or process, available data and decision to test.

sections.heading: Simulation and insight for everyday operations

items.title: Equipment failure prediction
items.description: Adapt an applicable model to equipment condition and operating behaviour, with model availability and fit confirmed during assessment.
items.bullets:
Inputs – condition and maintenance history
Output – failure-risk assessment
Decision – prioritise maintenance

items.title: Forecasting simulation
items.description: Test changed operating assumptions within an asset or process model, rather than only extending a historical forecast.
items.bullets:
Inputs – process data and scenario assumptions
Output – compared scenario results
Decision – review a proposed operational change

items.title: Inventory optimisation
items.description: Adapt inventory models to demand, replenishment rules and the constraints of the operating network.
items.bullets:
Inputs – stock, demand and replenishment data
Output – inventory scenario comparison
Decision – balance availability and stock

items.title: Real-time monitoring
items.description: Agree monitoring frequency around source refresh, connectivity and ingestion design so operational teams know how current each view will be.
items.bullets:
Inputs – operational readings and asset mapping
Output – current-state view at agreed refresh
Decision – review changes needing attention

sections.note: Select supported asset or process models and agree data formats, model fidelity and refresh conditions before committing to a pilot.

sections.heading: Build a twin around the decisions that matter
sections.description: Reuse provides a model starting point; operational modelling and calibration remain specific to the asset or process.

items.title: Scoped twin
items.description: Define the operational question, asset or process boundary and advisory scope.
items.bullets:
Reuse – applicable model starting point
Accept – decision brief and boundary

items.title: Data and model map
items.description: Map available sources to the model and record operational constraints.
items.bullets:
Tailor – source and asset mappings
Accept – data and fidelity assumptions

items.title: Calibrated scenarios
items.description: Check model behaviour against observed operations before comparing alternative scenarios.
items.bullets:
Tailor – calibration and assumptions
Accept – validation and scenario evidence

items.title: Monitored pilot
items.description: Let operational owners review outputs within a controlled decision pilot.
items.bullets:
Tailor – monitoring and review workflow
Accept – pilot and model-update plan

sections.note: Condition readings and maintenance history → a calibrated asset model → a changed operating or maintenance scenario → an engineer reviews the implications before a live change. This is a conceptual engagement example, not deployed client evidence.

sections.heading: What your first twin needs
sections.description: First value is a calibrated scenario that an operational owner can review. Data gaps, fidelity requirements and source integration determine the delivery plan.

items.title: Operational data
items.description: Establish whether the data can represent the asset or process at the fidelity needed.
items.bullets:
Provide – accessible operational history
Agree – asset boundary and source mapping
Check – refresh and connectivity dependencies

items.title: Calibration and control
items.description: Keep advisory decision support separate from any control or write-back capability.
items.bullets:
Name – calibration and operational owners
Agree – scenario validation criteria
Define – human review and write-back boundary

items.title: Environment and handover
items.description: Set hosting, access and monitoring responsibilities before introducing the twin into operations.
items.bullets:
Agree – hosting and integration scope
Define – model changes and access controls
Name – support and handover owners

sections.note: Accelerator adoption is scoped separately from software licensing. Agree the engagement model, reuse and handover rights, licence dependencies and ongoing support before delivery.

sections.heading: Put simulation in your operating context
sections.description: Potential uses include maintenance and operating scenarios in Manufacturing and Energy & Mining, with inventory planning in Retail, FMCG & CPG.

items.title: Predictive Analytics Suite
items.description: Use prediction and scoring to complement asset and process scenario modelling.

items.title: Power BI + AI/ML
items.description: Make model outputs available in reporting views for operational review.
